_doc: Shot A4: as A (a_raw: PA pa_wmed, MT mt_inner) but FL = mean of fl_med (fragment lines extrapolated to both aponeuroses) and v2_fl_chord_mid (mid-image thickness / sin of the depth-fitted mid-depth fascicle angle); independent errors average out: on the OSF expert benchmark (same FIJI protocol as the labels) FL MAE 8.47 -> 4.83 mm (debiased 5.30 -> 3.70). fl_scale keeps the test-set mean of fl_med so the LB-tuned blend weight stays comparable.
